name: json-field
title: JSON Field
description: JSON text field that validates as you type, shows a caret at the exact line and column, and repairs trailing commas, single or smart quotes, unquoted keys, comments, Python literals (True/None), missing commas and unclosed braces with a token-aware fix. Includes Format.

meta.summary: Validates JSON as you type, points at the exact line and column, and repairs the usual hand-editing mistakes in one tap.
catches: Single or smart quotes, and unquoted keys
Comments and Python literals such as True and None
Missing commas and unclosed braces or brackets
Exact line and column, the same in every browser
limits: Checks syntax only; no JSON Schema validation
Fixes are heuristic; review the result before saving
a11y: Visible label; textarea has aria-invalid and is described by the status
Status is a polite live region and problems wait for a pause while typing
Position button moves the caret to the problem
